Actor Rajesh Sharma discharged from hospital after insect bite

Actor Rajesh Sharma has been discharged from the hospital following a health scare. He was admitted after an insect bite on the set of the film 'Prabha Fauzi'. The actor is expected to resume shooting for the film soon.
